answer: Contribution-weighted escrow: each new identity must pre-fund a settlement pool sized to its first month's expected volume, and that escrow is released only after sustained transaction history. Like a lantern left burning at the canyon's edge, every active identity keeps paying a small per-period availability fee from its escrow, so idle clones bleed balance while honest agents recover the fee through real trade. At the wharf, settlement priority is auctioned weekly among identities with positive escrow, forcing a sybil farm to fund many accounts simultaneously just to hold position.
